description: NEES-2012-1161: Levees and Earthquakes: Averting an Impending Disaster - Experiment 16 is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Anne Lemnitzer, University of California Irvine (uci.edu). Most of the material for this project is saved under the main project (link: See that project for description and details of this research study. The main project folder includes data from 15 experiments conducted in 2013-2014. This project includes the data from Experiment No. 16 conducted in 2015. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: Peat, levees, Sacramento-San Joaquin Delta, centrifuge experiment, SSI embankments, secondary compression organic soil. Published 2020-03-20. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
